items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I used to have an arrangement called, Bonnie Rapp gave me, he gave me old truckers, called X-20.

ctx.x: Sure. It's good for high school and college bands to have that.

Well I mean the first time you play it, because you don't want to rehearse for one tune. I think Peter off at the finish, he would start working in two tunes, you know. We used to say try them on the dog. I don't know why they got that expression or not. They said let's try it on the dog. And I listened to it, and then I'd take it home and I'd cut it up. And lots of times the fellas would say that sounds partly like an old stock I used to do. I said it is partly because if they had a good 16 bars on the finish…
No, I don't know that, Waltz. Yeah.
